source.name: MLB.com / Arizona Diamondbacks: Arizona Diamondbacks and Avnet announce new partnership to include first ever jersey patch
source.quote: The Arizona Diamondbacks have entered a multi-year partnership with Avnet that will include the company's "A" and name on the sleeve of the D-backs' jerseys beginning with the 2023 season

source.name: MLB.com: MLB, Nike and Fanatics form 10-year partnership
source.note: Kit maker. The league-wide 10-year deal makes Nike the exclusive on-field uniform supplier of all 30 MLB clubs from 2020, so the Diamondbacks' shirts carry the Nike Swoosh. The club's kit launch for 2026/27 is not on the club site.
source.quote: makes Nike the Official Uniform and Footwear Supplier of MLB starting in the 2020 season

summary: Jersey patch: Avnet, on the sleeve. Nike is the kit maker (league-wide MLB uniform supplier).
